sentence: Spur gear pair, module 1, 20 and 40 teeth, bores with keyways, centre distance certified
design_notes: Both gears built by the gear feature: standard spur gears, module 1, 20 degree ISO 53 profile A basic rack, no profile shift, tooth thickness reduced 0.025 each (0.05 circular backlash for the pair); involute flanks as certified circular arcs. The wheel is turned half a pitch (4.5 deg) so a tooth space faces the pinion. Bores 8 and 10 with DIN 6885-1 hub keyways built by the keyway feature from the records (2 wide, t2 1.0; 3 wide, t2 1.4). Face width 8.
